task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Place the office stapler with plastic and metal parts into the drawer of the storage cabinet after sliding it open.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架，将带有塑料和金属部件的办公订书机滑开后放入储物柜的抽屉中。
